description: Cancel a scheduled calendar post in the workspace and its pending auto-recycle entries (reposts and reshares waiting on it). Statuses become canceled and the records are kept. Requires a workspace-scoped key or workspace_id. aidelly_cancel_post cancels only the single post. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_cancel_scheduled_post
title: Cancel Scheduled Post
